thread:
nina: Heads up 0min ago the invoice-preview dashboard shows a short-lived token spike for tenant 'brightleaf' during the routing-resolver v3 canary. Final ledger does NOT show the same spike.

raj: Spike where? which route/tenant?

nina: Preview top-level card: tokens=1.8M between 14:02-14:06 (ui/preview -> invoice preview). Ledger: 1.0M. Preview is double-ish.

claire: Any chance preview is counting fallback merges as separate events? We changed fallback policy in v3 to emit route_candidates for transparency.

nina: That's what I suspect. Sample raw event from preview topic:
```json
{
  "req_id": "req-444",
  "tenant": "brightleaf",
  "tokens": 1024,
  "route_candidates": ["r-text-6","r-backup-legacy"],
  "resolved_route": "r-text-6"
}
```

tom: Ah, the preview join logic was naive: it expanded route_candidates into multiple attribution rows for debugging visibility. Ledger pipeline collapses to single resolved_route -> so preview double-counts when route_candidates length>1.

nina: That explains the ~2x. But we still have to support route_candidates in the console UX.

raj: Short-term mitigation: change preview aggregation to group by req_id and take a single top-priority route (resolved_route) before summing tokens. That will make preview match ledger. Longer-term: prefer emitting route_candidates as metadata, not as separate attribution events.

claire: Also we should add a metric preview.attribution_dedupe_rate (gauge) and an alert when > 0.3% over 10m. If we had that, oncall would've seen the anomaly before customers.

observability-bot: alert: preview.attribution_dedupe_rate p95=0.9% over last 5m for cluster preview-01 (link: http://dash/alerts/987)

product-bot: Should we proactively message customers who saw preview spikes? How many tenants affected?

nina: Quick query I ran: SELECT tenant, count(*) as dup_events FROM preview_events WHERE array_length(route_candidates,1) > 1 AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-18 14:00' AND '2026-03-18 14:10' GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY dup_events DESC LIMIT 5; result: brightleaf (3.2k), acme-inc (1.1k), beta-labs (300).

tom: Owners: @raj - patch preview aggregator to dedupe by req_id and prefer resolved_route; @claire - add metric + pager rule; @nina - coordinate customer comms + run backfill reconcile script to emit correction events so preview aligns historically; @tom - rolling back v3 canary if patch isn't safe in 30m.

raj: I'll open PR (preview-service#452) to group-by req_id at ingest stage and add a lightweight dedupe cache for 60s. Plan to deploy to canary now.

claire: I'll add the metric and alert in observability repo and create a dashboard card showing dedupe_rate by tenant.

nina: Backfill plan: run job that reads preview_events WHERE dup flag true and emits a single corrected preview row per req_id then diff against ledger and write reconciliation report. I'll post results here.

observability-bot: deploy: preview-aggregator v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2 canary triggered by raj at 6754329884

product-bot: For external comms, keep it factual: explain preview may have overcounted during canary window, invoices are correct, we will surface reconciled previews in console and notify affected customers. I'll draft a short blurb once we have numbers.

tom: If the canary patch fixes counts, we don't need rollback. If not fixed in 30m, I'll stop v3 resolver canary and revert to v2.

nina: Thanks team. I'll report back with backfill diff and a proposed console changelog entry. :thumbsup:
